name: Soft Film by Leno Cainelli
recipeMemo:
Comments from the Creator
The Soft Film recipe gives your photos a gentle, dreamy look with soft focus, a subtle touch of color, and a flatter contrast profile. It adds a warm, timeless tint to your shots, while staying true to the original color scheme. It works well in a wide range of scenes, such as capturing romantic, intimate moments in portraits, creating peaceful, serene landscapes, giving lifestyle shots a subtle touch of color, and adding a nostalgic touch to wedding or engagement photos.
